entries.message: This update keeps a season's card just below the top bar when you open it, on every show.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Keep season scrolling landing just below the top bar
Fix: Clicking a season, or opening a URL that names one, now lands its card just below the top bar on every show
Fix: Seasons no longer stop hidden under the top bar or short of their position when a season card above them resizes during the scroll
Fix: Scrolling by hand while the page is settling stops the adjustment at once

Fix: The episode box no longer sits below its card when a season card above it changes height after the page renders

entries.message: This update adds per-season posters and season cards for TV shows, a text size slider, Up Next and dashboard fixes, and watch-history restore status on Backups.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Tweak: Dashboard history cards show their details beside episode artwork across desktop widths, with posters filling the card height in a wider fixed column
Tweak: Give the playlist import dialog more room for its app list.
Tweak: Text size slider from 100% to 130% in the sidebar Appearance panel scales the text across Plekt, and the chosen size is saved on the Plekt server and applied when Plekt loads
Tweak: Up Next shows the episode or movie that is playing at the top of the rail while it plays
Tweak: Up Next shows one card per episode: a part-watched card and a next-up card for the same episode are merged into the part-watched one
Tweak: Up Next keeps its order on refresh: a card waiting to be removed stays in its place instead of jumping to the top
Tweak: Appearance sits between Settings and About in the left menu, and the app version label sits above both theme switches at the foot of the sidebar instead of between them
Tweak: TV shows group and pick posters more reliably when a show has several matching entries
Tweak: Sync activity refreshes and retries more reliably after a failed request

Tweak: A cached poster whose file has gone missing is downloaded again when it is next requested, and a poster with no downloadable source returns not found, so the artwork fallback shows instead of a broken image

Tweak: Select or upload a poster for each season in Edit Images from TMDB, TVDB, and fanart.tv; season overrides stay separate, so episode, dashboard, and upcoming cards can use them without changing show or episode artwork
Tweak: Preserve saved season poster choices in portable and encrypted backups
Tweak: Open season's episodes sit beside its card on desktop, with one outline that joins the card and the episode box seamlessly, a curved bottom joint, and matching colours in light mode
Tweak: Clicking a season scrolls its card to just below the top bar, also when the app is zoomed out
Tweak: Season episodes show five to a row on desktop
Tweak: Season rows show a poster: the season's own poster, the series poster when a season has none, and one-season shows get posters too; desktop season posters are larger
Tweak: Watched-status edits you make are no longer refused while a watch-history restore is running or has failed; automated sync still waits for it
Tweak: Settings > Backups shows a running or failed watch-history restore with its error, and a Clear Status button to release it
